summary: This is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by Lantronix Inc. for a registered offering of 4,166,667 shares of common stock at $7.20 per share, expected to close June 1, 2026. The filing is a routine at-the-market (or firm commitment) shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement, not a special situation. The proceeds of ~$28.5M will go to the company. No strategic event, merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing is purely a capital raising transaction with no special-situation attributes.
